svg.aria-label: Mission 02: CRA Clock. 24 hours starts the moment you know. The EU Cyber Resilience Act reporting clock as a GitHub Action: an SBOM from 12 lockfile formats, checked against OSV, CISA KEV and EPSS, with Article 14 deadlines and drafts. Status: live, GitHub Action, v1. Launched 10 OCT 2026. uses: GautamTalksDev/cra-clock@v1. Opens craclock.gautamkhosla.com.
